module_summary: Two-state Moore FSM (Lemmings) toggling walk direction on bump inputs, async reset to walk-left, outputs decoded from state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 1-bit WL/WR state register flipped by bumps; decodes walk_left and walk_right.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output high in WL state.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Moore output high in WR state, complement of walk_left.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Bump-driven next-state logic, direction state register and walk output decode.
